title: TFTrack: A Template-Free Framework for Efficient 3D Point Cloud Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.07738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LiDAR-based 3D Single Object Tracking (3D SOT) is critical for robotic perception and navigation and aims to localize dynamic objects across frames in sparse point clouds. Existing methods, rooted in the Siamese tracking paradigm from 2D vision, rely on costly dual-input designs and excessive motion modeling guided by template priors, hindering their efficiency. Our in-depth analysis reveals: (i) the template paradigm is redundant, as the previous bounding box center encodes sufficient historical context; (ii) complex motion modeling is unnecessary, as geometric alignment provides adequate motion priors. Based on the above findings, we propose the first Template-Free Tracking framework (TFTrack). The novel framework eliminates the need for template-search pairings and operates directly on the current frame guided solely by the prior bounding box center and size. We instantiate this paradigm into three variants: TFTrack-Voxel, TFTrack-P

translated_title: TFTrack：一种用于高效3D点云跟踪的无模板框架
translated_abstract: 基于激光雷达的3D单目标跟踪（3D SOT）对机器人感知与导航至关重要，其目标是在稀疏点云中跨帧定位动态物体。现有方法根植于2D视觉中的孪生跟踪范式，依赖成本高昂的双输入设计以及由模板先验引导的过度运动建模，从而阻碍了其效率。我们的深入分析表明：(i) 模板范式是冗余的，因为前一帧的边界框中心已编码了足够的历史上下文信息；(ii) 复杂的运动建模是不必要的，因为几何对齐本身就能提供充分的运动先验。基于上述发现，我们提出了首个无模板跟踪框架（TFTrack）。这一新颖框架消除了模板-搜索区域配对的需求，仅在先验边界框中心和尺寸的引导下直接在当前帧上运行。我们将该范式实例化为三个变体：TFTrack-Voxel、TFTrack-P……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个无模板3D单目标跟踪框架TFTrack，通过深入分析证明模板范式冗余且复杂运动建模不必要，仅依靠先验边界框中心和尺寸并结合几何对齐即可实现高效的3D点云跟踪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TFTrack, the first template-free framework for 3D single object tracking, demonstrating that the template paradigm is redundant and complex motion modeling is unnecessary, thereby achieving efficient 3D point cloud tracking using only the prior bounding box center and size along with geometric alignment.
